metal_nonmetal_property_swap.feedback: Metals are lustrous, malleable, ductile, and good conductors; most non-metals are dull and brittle.
metal_nonmetal_property_swap.calm_prompt: Compare physical properties side by side.

reactivity_series_order_error.feedback: More reactive metals displace less reactive metals from salt solutions; order matters.
reactivity_series_order_error.calm_prompt: Use the series: K Na Ca Mg Al Zn Fe Pb Cu Hg Ag.

ionic_bond_covalent_confusion.feedback: Ionic compounds form by electron transfer (e.g. Na⁺ and Cl⁻), not by sharing electrons.
ionic_bond_covalent_confusion.calm_prompt: Metal loses electrons; non-metal gains them.

displacement_reactivity_error.feedback: Zinc displaces copper from CuSO₄ because Zn is more reactive than Cu.
displacement_reactivity_error.calm_prompt: Check if the free metal is above the metal in the compound.

corrosion_prevention_wrong.feedback: Galvanisation coats iron with zinc; painting and oiling block air and moisture.
